thesis: The site is the farm's morning clock: every section is stamped with the hour it happens on the farm, so a parent understands why the stand opens early and why the peaches taste like that.

signature.name: Dawn Chalk Ledger
signature.summary: A vertical chalk-style ledger strip on the left margin (sticky desktop, inline pill mobile) whose timestamp advances from 5:45 to 18:00 as sections enter view; each section carries its hour in condensed chalk type. Reused in hero, process, ripe board, proof, contact and footer. Hook: data-sw-signature='dawn-chalk-ledger'.

motion.intro: Sky lightens from night to dawn in 1.1s; first timestamp chalks on with staggered letter reveal.
stories: Chalk list at #ripe wipes in line-by-line on entry.
motion.hover: Buttons lift 2px with peach shadow; ledger timestamps glow faintly.
